newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER - SHANGHAI CELEBRATE BIG VICTORY IN CHINA SOCCER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER - SHANGHAI CELEBRATE BIG VICTORY IN CHINA SOCCER.

text.p: - Last season's runner-up Shanghai Shenhua hammered Guangdong Hongyuan 4-1 in their away game in the third round of the Chinese soccer league in Guangzhou on Thursday.
The visiting squad showed all-round superiority throughout the game, the Xinhua news agency said in an overnight report.
Shanghai opened the score in the 18th minute and scored again in the 61st minute when striker Xie Hui headed home on a corner-kick from teammate Shen Si.
The match turned ill-tempered in the middle of the second half after the home team conceded two goals in just four minutes, both from penalties.
Guangdong goal-keeper Ou Chuliang, also national squad keeper, offered a penalty chance to his opponents after he brought down a Shanghai forward.
Substitute Qi Hong gained the second penalty for Shanghai.
The host team finally got some consolation when Li Yuzhan scored their only goal on a rebound from a freekick, just two minutes before the final whistle.

"Anyway, my players had tried their best, " said Guo Yijun, head coach of the Guangdong team. "Obviously, the Shanghai team are stronger than us. They gave us much pressure, leaving us little chance to enter their area."
The coach said Guangdong's loose defence was another reason for their loss.
Dalian Wanda extended their unbeaten record to 37 matches after outplaying Tianjin Lifei 2-0 to collect three straight wins after three rounds this season.
Teenager Wang Peng opened the score in the 17th minute while Zhang Enhua, defender of the Chinese national team, added the second goal.
In other matches of the day, Qingdao Hainiu defeated Vanguards Huandao 2-0. Hainiu now shares second place in the league with Shanghai Shenhua.
Beijing Guo'an beat Jinan Taishan 2-1, Sichuan Quanxing beat Yanbian Aodong 3-1 and August First drew with Guangzhou Apollo 0-0.
